name: Albatross Company disputed host-company relationship

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel-reported Member State allegation disputed by Viet Nam

caveats: Albatross remains a separate entity classification; DPRK front-company status is unassigned in this output.
The host-country response belongs alongside the Member State allegation; the relationship remains allegation-level.
The reported exposure stays within the cited source boundary; a natural-person identity requires additional evidence.
Viet Nam replied that its authorities reported zero DPRK workers or IT experts working in Albatross and gave contrary travel information about a related DPRK national.

statements: A Member State reported that Vietnamese Albatross Company (Albatross Co. Ltd.) worked with DPRK IT developers assessed to remain in Viet Nam as of November 2019.

sources.support: Verifies Albatross, Korea National Development Investment Company, Mangyongdae, the reported sourcing relationship and Viet Nam response
